customerType.description:
This field signifies the type of customer we are dealing with in this transaction. Supported values are B2B and B2G.
  * `B2B` - Business to business
  * `B2G` - Business to government

Contact.description: A group of business terms providing contact information

name.description: Name of contact person.  One needs to be filled out if the seller contact tag is used

telephone.description: Phone number of contact person.  One needs to be filled out if the seller contact tag is used

responseCode.description:
response code
  * `ERR` - Error
  * `INI` - Initiated
  * `INP` - In progress
  * `SUC` - Success
  * `CLA` - Clearance accepted
  * `CLR` - Clearance rejected
  * `BRI` - Business response initiated
  * `BUA` - Business accepted
  * `BUR` - Business rejected
  * `CAN` - Cancel
  * `CCA` - Conditionally accepted
  * `DDP` - Deadline passed

reasonCode.description:
reason codes
  * `UNAUTHORIZED` - User is not authorized
  * `BAD_REQUEST` - Input is not correct
  * `PUF_TRANSFORMATION_FAILED` - Failure at puf transformation 
  * `XSD_VALIDATION_FAILED` - Failure at puf validation through XSD 
  * `SCHEMATRON_VALIDATION_FAILED` - Failure at puf validation through Schematron 
  * `FAILED_TO_SUBMIT` - Failed to submit to Pagero 
  * `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` - An internal server error has occured for unknown reason 
  * `FAILED_POST_SUBMIT` - Failed after submission to Pagero
  * `DOCUMENT_CANCELLED_SUCCESSFULLY` - Document cancelled successfully
  * `AWAITING_BUSINESS_RESPONSE` - Business response is required & is still pending
  * `NOT_AWAITING_BUSINESS_RESPONSE` - Business response is not required
  * `AWAITING_CLEARANCE_RESPONSE` - Clearance response is required & is still pending
  * `NOT_AWAITING_CLEARANCE_RESPONSE` - Clearance response is not required
